findings.title: Spawned workers bypass the restart kill guard
findings.description: Workers created by `get_context("spawn").Process` are not instances of `multiprocessing.Process` (verified locally). Consequently, hung workers are never killed before their replacements start, leaving multiple workers flushing the same shards. Use `multiprocessing.process.BaseProcess` or distinguish processes from threads explicitly, and test hung-worker replacement.

findings.title: Shutdown skips remaining workers after the deadline
findings.description: When downstream shutdown or an earlier worker exhausts the timeout, `break` skips cleanup for all remaining workers. Workers blocked in Redis or Kafka can survive rebalances. Limit waiting by the deadline, but perform termination cleanup for every worker.

findings.title: Memory checks repeat a full cluster scan per worker
findings.description:
`SpansBuffer.get_memory_info()` queries the entire Redis cluster, regardless of assigned shards (`src/sentry/spans/buffer.py:375-376`). Calling it for every worker repeats identical cluster-wide work on each submission when memory checks are enabled. Query the shared cluster once instead.

Project tests could not run: the available Python environment lacks `pytest`.
